# Bauhu

Bauhu designs architect-led homes and building systems for remote, coastal and hurricane-exposed sites. The company combines architectural design, precision-engineered steel-frame construction, manufacture, procurement, logistics and delivery planning for locations where conventional construction is difficult to control.

## Core positioning

- Architect-designed residences supported by a precision-engineered building system.
- Relevant for remote island, coastal, hurricane-exposed and hard-to-build sites.
- Suitable for custom residences, adaptable home models, resorts, retreats, private estates, staff villages and multi-building residential projects.
- Especially relevant across the Caribbean, The Bahamas and other hurricane-exposed coastal locations.
- Project feasibility, approvals, shipping, local works, code requirements and appointed professional input are reviewed location by location.

## Main routes

- Custom Design: fully tailored architectural residences developed around a specific brief, site and lifestyle.
- Home Models: architect-designed starting points that can be adapted around site, climate, views, budget, bedroom requirements and delivery route.
- Remote Locations: Bauhu plans design, manufacture, packing, shipping, unloading, site access and local completion around difficult locations.
- Engineering: Bauhu homes are engineered for demanding coastal and hurricane-exposed locations, with the structural strategy developed around the specific site, exposure, geometry and applicable local code.
- Site Fit: the enquiry route is designed to qualify leads by location, site conditions, project type, budget, timing and feasibility.
- Work With Bauhu: a professional route for contractors, consultants, logistics partners, local delivery teams and project introducers who can support Bauhu projects.

## Typical operating regions

Bauhu is suited to projects across The Bahamas, Turks and Caicos, the US Virgin Islands, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Antigua and Barbuda, Anguilla, St Barthélemy, St Martin / Sint Maarten, Barbados, Jamaica, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, St Lucia, Grenada, St Vincent and the Grenadines, Trinidad and Tobago, Bermuda, Florida and other hurricane-exposed coastal locations.
